Attributes.description: The configurable attributes of the proxy, as a list of key-value pairs. Attributes you omit are set to their service-assigned defaults, and removing one from your template resets it to its default. Some attributes can be set only at creation; changing one afterward fails and leaves the proxy unchanged. The AWS WAF setup is one such create-time choice: no web ACL is attached unless you set waf.web_acl_arn at creation to a web ACL you own.
Attributes.markdownDescription:
The configurable attributes of the proxy, as a list of key-value pairs. Attributes you omit are set to their service-assigned defaults, and removing one from your template resets it to its default. The AWS WAF setup is one such create-time choice: no web ACL is attached unless you set waf.web_acl_arn at creation to a web ACL you own.
